{{Quote|This is my first time commanding a squadron, Arseven. Let's make a good impression.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
'''R7-A7''', also known as '''Arseven''', was [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Color/Legends|yellow-green]], red, and white [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-programmed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
R7-A7, also known as Arseven, was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-programmed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who served with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served as [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] of her [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], flying with her on a mission to take out the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade surrounding [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. He was present when she disobeyed orders to retreat after Separatist reinforcements arrived and lost most of her squadron.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

After the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] retreated, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came up with a plan to pilot the heavily damaged ''Defender'' into the Confederacy's flagship, while Tano and her squad of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] took out the remaining enemy frigates. Tano was still shaken from her earlier failure, but received support from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and led the counterattack. Arseven flew with Tano in her Y-wing. The attack was successful, and the Republic forces prepared to invade Ryloth and liberate the captive [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants from [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] leader [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].

The droid also co-piloted her [[Ahsoka Tano's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] during the [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Defense of Cato Neimoidia]].

==Characteristics==
R7-A7 had [[Color/Legends|yellow-green]], red, and white plating.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ahsoka_R7A7.png|thumb|right|200px|R7-A7 in the droid socket of Ahsoka's Delta-7B]]
R7-A7 was first revealed in the [[2009]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set "[[W:c:lego:7751 Ahsoka's Starfighter and Vulture Droid|Ahsoka's Starfighter and Droids]]."
